description: This file contains the LegendMapper class responsible for mapping chart legend elements from a document object model to a PdfSharp chart object within the MigraDoc rendering process.

classes.name: LegendMapper
classes.description: A class that handles mapping of legend elements from the document object model to the chart object.

methods.name: MapObject
methods.description: Maps legend elements from the DOM chart object to the PdfSharp chart, setting the legend position and formatting details.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Static method that creates an instance of LegendMapper to perform the mapping between chart objects.
